integrity: The continuous-to-cubical map and all-dimensional orbit-cell classifications are proved; the finite verifier is supporting evidence only. A previously published three-dimensional case is explicitly credited. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two unordered particles and the full graph automorphism group. General proof is structural; exact finite checks only through dimension five. Does not classify Borel orbit spaces or proper symmetry subgroups. Novelty is conditional on indexed and inspected literature.
title: A collapsible triangular model for every hypercube two-point symmetry quotient
